definitionOfDone: After the change, the code and every doc agree. Either nothing documents a per-task maxReopens override, or the override is settable through a validated tool input with tests. With option (c), every doc that names it says no tool sets it.

qa_reject's reply still returns the effective cap as `maxReopens`, and the existing reopen-cap behaviour still holds with fresh vitest results: the soft-cap re-plan at 3, then the hard-cap park with needsHumanReview at 4, and the repeated-DoD-item flip.

The vitest files that reference maxReopens (qaReject, governanceFeatures, lifecycle e2e, parkedReview.guard, qaVerdictHandoff, taskTimeBudgetDocs) pass, and the summary names the option chosen and why.

implementationPlan.description:
Remove the dead override from the code. Edit tool only.
(1) packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts:
 a. Replace the JSDoc of MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT (~:378-382, the block ending ` * Override per-task via `task.maxReopens`.`) with:
```
/**
 * Cap on QA reopen cycles, the same for every task: there is no per-task override
 * (the `_DEFAULT` suffix is historical). After this many rejections, qa_reject
 * sends the task back to PLANNING for re-planning instead of WORKING.
 */
```
 Keep `export const MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT = 3;` with its name and value: SCHEMA.md, MCP_SERVER.md and the LIVE_TERMS 'reopen cap' guard in util/taskTimeBudgetDocs.test.ts all reference it.
 b. In `interface Task`, delete `maxReopens?: number;` and the 5-line JSDoc above it (~:985-990, 'Hard cap on QA reopen cycles before the task is auto-flipped back to PLANNING ... Defaults to MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT (3).').
(2) packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaReject.ts:
 a. Tool description (:23): replace `reaches the task\'s reopen cap (task.maxReopens, default 3) or` with `reaches the reopen cap (3) or`. The rest of the description stays byte-identical.
 b. Escalation comment (~:205-206): replace `// Bounded escalation. Two tiers off the reopen cap (default` and `// MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT (3), per-task override via task.maxReopens):` with `// Bounded escalation. Two tiers off the reopen cap, MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT` and `// (3) for every task (there is no per-task override):`.
 c. Replace the 3-line ternary at ~:221-223 (`const maxReopens = typeof task.maxReopens === 'number' && task.maxReopens > 0` / `? task.maxReopens` / `: MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT;`) with exactly `      const maxReopens = MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT;`, with a 6-space indent, because checkRefs[0] greps the whole line. Keep the local's name: it feeds the reply's maxReopens field (:464), the three TASK_REOPENED activity payloads and the park and soft-cap chat messages, all unchanged.
Error handling: this step adds no failure path, so it adds no error handling code. The cap is a constant, so there is nothing to validate. A task file that still carries a maxReopens key loads unchanged, and the key is ignored. Do not add validation or a migration, and do not strip the key (epic rail: stay backward-compatible with existing .moe/ state files). After this step, the new step-1 test passes.

implementationPlan.description:
Make the docs describe the fixed cap. Edit tool only. Touch only the passages named here: checkRefs[1] strip-diffs everything outside SCHEMA.md `## Task` and `### Reopen cap`, and outside MCP_SERVER.md `### moe.qa_reject`.
(1) docs/SCHEMA.md:
 a. In `interface Task` (~:495), delete the line `  maxReopens?: number;                          // Per-task override of MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT (3)`.
 b. In `### Reopen cap` (~:1115-1118):
 - change ``auto-flips a task from `WORKING` back to `PLANNING` `` to read ``from `REVIEW` ``, because qa_reject only acts on REVIEW rows;
 - replace item 1, ``1. `reopenCount ≥ task.maxReopens ?? MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT`, or``, with ``1. `reopenCount ≥ MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT` and the task has had no cap re-plan yet (`capReplanAt` unset), or``.
 c. After the paragraph that ends ``emits a `TASK_REOPENED` activity event with the rejection history.``, add a blank line and then this paragraph: ``The cap is the same for every task: there is no per-task override. Once `capReplanAt` is set, a rejection past the cap (`reopenCount ≥ MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT + 1`) parks the task in `REVIEW` for a human (`needsHumanReview`) instead of flipping it again.`` This matches qaReject.ts, where hardCap = maxReopens + 1 and reachedHardCap requires capReplanAt. Item 1 alone would otherwise imply that every rejection at 3 or more flips.
(2) docs/MCP_SERVER.md, the auto-flip bullet in `### moe.qa_reject` (~:2405): replace ``(default 3 via `MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT`; per-task override `task.maxReopens`)`` with ``(`MAX_REOPENS_DEFAULT`, 3, the same for every task: there is no per-task override)``. Keep the Returns line `reopenCount, maxReopens, exceededReopenCap: boolean,` (~:2385) unchanged: the reply field stays.
The exact phrase `there is no per-task override` must appear in both sections, which checkRefs[1] checks. No added line may contain a project.json globalRails.forbiddenPatterns string.

Error handling for a red run:
- SCOPE-FAIL prints the changed files: revert any file outside the 7, and treat a missing file as a skipped step.
- OVERRIDE-STILL-NAMED prints the offending line: fix it.
- CODE-FAIL, PHRASE-FAIL or REPLY-FIELD-FAIL means the exact line or phrase from step 2 or 3 is missing.
- SECTION-FAIL prints the stray diff: revert it.
- A vitest failure: fix the code or the fixture, never weaken an assertion.
- A tsc error names a remaining reader of task.maxReopens: remove that reader.
- If npm ci fails on network or cache, retry once. If it fails again, call moe.report_blocked with the npm error tail. Never fall back to npm in the shared checkout.
See mem:decision-doc-row-checkrefs-worktree-mode for the snapshot pattern.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Option (a), remove the override: CHOSEN. Its only reader is qaReject.ts:221-223. It never had a writer: no tool input, no daemon assignment, no IDE client, and 0 of 1064 live task files carry it. Three fixtures set it, and only to RAISE the cap so that it would not fire:
- governanceFeatures.test.ts and lifecycle.e2e.test.ts do two rejections (count 2 < 3), so the default already holds.
- The ToolTestHarness test in qaReject.test.ts does three rejections. One reopenCount reset before its third rejection keeps it below the cap.
So deleting the override costs no more than documenting it. Option (b), a bounded create_task input, was rejected: no consumer needs a tunable cap, and it would add API surface plus validation. Option (c), a documented test seam, was rejected: it would print an unsupported knob in SCHEMA.md, MCP_SERVER.md and an agent-facing tool description, and keep dead flexibility.
The gate is narrow, though isEpicFinal is true. That is only the order fallback (epic-be924fb8 has no finalTaskId), and the governor asked for the named vitest files plus the docs test. tsc -p . --noEmit covers the shared-type blast radius of the Task field removal.
